scripts.db:migrate:company: sh -c 'set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @ksiegowy/api exec prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma'
scripts.db:migrate:household: sh -c 'set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @ksiegowy/household-service exec prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma'
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run db:migrate:company && pnpm run db:migrate:household
scripts.db:studio:company: sh -c 'set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @ksiegowy/api exec prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma'
scripts.db:studio:household: sh -c 'set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @ksiegowy/household-service exec prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma'
scripts.backup:postgres: docker compose --profile backup run --rm -e DB_BACKUP_DATABASE_LABEL=all backup-postgres

scripts.backup:postgres:household: docker compose --profile backup run --rm -e DB_BACKUP_DATABASE_LABEL=household backup-postgres

scripts.backup:postgres:local:company: docker compose --profile backup run --rm -e DB_BACKUP_ENVIRONMENT_NAME=local -e DB_BACKUP_DATABASE_LABEL=business -e DB_BACKUP_REMOTE_PRIMARY_NAME= -e DB_BACKUP_REMOTE_SECONDARY_NAME= backup-postgres
scripts.backup:postgres:local:household: docker compose --profile backup run --rm -e DB_BACKUP_ENVIRONMENT_NAME=local -e DB_BACKUP_DATABASE_LABEL=household -e DB_BACKUP_REMOTE_PRIMARY_NAME= -e DB_BACKUP_REMOTE_SECONDARY_NAME= backup-postgres
